# Packages installed inside the shared Debian 12 build root.
# Read by env/bootstrap.sh and env/verify.sh; edit here, not in the scripts.
#
# The root is created with mmdebstrap --variant=apt, which omits
# Priority: required packages, and live-build declares almost no dependencies
# (Depends: debootstrap). Everything it calls at runtime must be listed.

live-build
debootstrap

# rootfs + ISO mastering
squashfs-tools
xorriso
genisoimage
mtools
dosfstools

# UEFI + hybrid boot
grub-efi-amd64-bin
grub-pc-bin
syslinux-common
isolinux

# chroot setup
ca-certificates
debian-archive-keyring
locales
console-setup
file
less

# runtime requirements of live-build scripts (not declared upstream)
mount
util-linux
rsync
cpio
xz-utils
apt-utils
e2fsprogs
parted
gawk
bc
